name: Oregano

schedule.notes: Tiny seeds — surface-sow on damp mix, don't cover.
Best flavor just as flower buds form. Cut whole stems back to 2 in for a second flush.

harvest.cues: Stems 6 to 8 in. Pinch out flowers to keep leaves flavorful.
harvest.storageNotes: Dries excellently — bundle and hang in shade 2 to 3 weeks. Flavor concentrates.

varieties.name: Greek (Origanum heracleoticum)
varieties.notes: The true pizza oregano. Pungent, slightly hot.

varieties.name: Italian (Origanum × majoricum)
varieties.notes: Milder, sweeter. Marjoram x oregano cross.

notes: Hates wet feet — plant in lean, well-drained soil and don't fertilize. Rich soil and water make it tasteless. Divide every 3 to 4 years to refresh.
